goal: Implement all remaining phases (3–6) and Tier 7 items (7.5–7.12) from docs/findings-and-improvements.md. Phases 0, 1, and 2 are already complete. Use TDD: write tests first, then implement. Verify at each phase boundary with build. Phases: 3 (Hybrid Chunking + Local Embedding), 4 (Advanced Retrieval), 5 (Graph Architecture), 6 (New Investigators + Testing), 7 (Pipeline Integrity Remainder).

steps.title: Phase 3: Error-aware log chunking with dedup (3.1 + 3.5)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/chunker.test.ts for a new `chunkLogFileErrorAware` function that produces three chunk types: (1) preamble chunk (first 20–30 lines), (2) error-cluster chunks centered on `extractErrorWindows` output with 10-line padding and dedup via `deduplicateLogLines`, (3) summary chunk describing healthy regions. Then implement `chunkLogFileErrorAware` in src/graph/chunker.ts. Wire it into src/ai/chunk-indexer.ts `buildChunkIndex` as the default log chunking strategy (replacing fixed 50-line window). Update the chunker index export in src/graph/index.ts. Tests must verify: preamble always included, error clusters deduped, summary chunk for healthy regions, backward-compatible when no errors exist (entire file in one chunk). Update any existing tests that assert specific log chunk counts.

steps.title: Phase 3: Resource summary content for chunks (3.3) + embed content not summaries (2.8)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/chunker.test.ts verifying that `chunkResource` uses `summarizeResource` output as LLM-facing `content`, and stores raw JSON in `metadata.rawContent`. Write tests in src/ai/__tests__/chunk-indexer.test.ts verifying that log chunk summaries include primary error lines (not just 'Log chunk from path (lines N-M)'). Then implement: (1) Modify `chunkResource` in src/graph/chunker.ts to use summary as content, stash raw JSON in metadata. (2) Modify `augmentLogChunk` in src/ai/chunk-indexer.ts to embed meaningful content (truncated to ~500 tokens) or prepend primary error lines to the summary string so semantic search can match log content. Update existing tests that assert against old chunk content format.

steps.title: Phase 3: Token budget awareness in chunk merge (3.4)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/ai-investigator.test.ts verifying: (1) a `estimateTokens(text)` utility returns content.length/4, (2) `mergeChunks` tracks cumulative tokens and respects a configurable budget (default ~80% of 128k context = ~100k tokens), (3) when budget is exceeded lower-priority chunks fall back to summary-only content. Then implement: add `estimateTokens` helper in src/ai/chunk-indexer.ts, extend the `mergeChunks` function (or add a `mergeChunksWithBudget` wrapper) in src/investigators/ai-investigator.ts to accept a tokenBudget param, switch low-priority chunks to `chunk.summary` when approaching budget. Wire into `investigateWithAI`.

steps.title: Phase 3: Local embedding backend with interface (3.6)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/ai/__tests__/local-embeddings.test.ts and src/ai/__tests__/embeddings.test.ts verifying: (1) an `EmbeddingClientInterface` interface with `embed(texts)` and `embedSingle(text)` methods, (2) a `LocalEmbeddingClient` class that calls a configurable HTTP endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:8080/embed), (3) graceful degradation: TEI → Ollama → OpenAI → no semantic retrieval, (4) config reads SBI_EMBEDDING_BACKEND, SBI_EMBEDDING_URL, SBI_EMBEDDING_MODEL env vars. Then implement: (1) Create src/ai/local-embeddings.ts with `LocalEmbeddingClient`, (2) extract `EmbeddingClientInterface` in src/ai/embeddings.ts and have both classes implement it, (3) update src/ai/config.ts with new env vars and `EmbeddingBackend` type, (4) create factory function `createEmbeddingClient(config)` that returns the right client, (5) wire into src/pipeline/analyze.ts pipeline. Export from src/ai/index.ts. Tests mock HTTP calls, no real external service needed.

steps.title: Phase 3: Late chunking infrastructure (3.2)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/ai/__tests__/late-chunking.test.ts verifying: (1) `mapChunkBoundariesToTokenPositions` maps line-range chunk boundaries to token index ranges, (2) `averagePoolSlice` average-pools a slice of a token-level embedding tensor, (3) `lateChunkEmbed` orchestrates: send full document to token-level endpoint, slice at boundaries, pool. Then implement src/ai/late-chunking.ts with these functions. The `lateChunkEmbed` function accepts a `LocalEmbeddingClient` that supports token-level output (TEI) and chunk boundaries from error-aware chunking. Falls back to standard per-chunk embedding when TEI is unavailable. Tests use mocked token-level embedding responses. Export from src/ai/index.ts.

steps.title: Phase 3: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify all Phase 3 changes compile correctly and produce valid output bundles. No new code — just verification that tsup produces correct dist/ output with all new modules.

steps.title: Phase 4: Contextual retrieval (2.3)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/ai/__tests__/contextual-retrieval.test.ts verifying: (1) `generateChunkContext(document, chunkContent)` returns a short context sentence like 'This chunk is from the Pod spec for app-pod in namespace default. It describes container environment variables.', (2) `contextualizeChunks(chunks, documents)` prepends context to each chunk's content before embedding, (3) both raw and contextualized content are stored. Then implement src/ai/contextual-retrieval.ts with these functions. The context generation uses a simple template-based approach per artifact category (no LLM call for V1 — can upgrade to LLM-generated context later). Integrate into buildChunkIndex in src/ai/chunk-indexer.ts so each chunk gets a `contextualizedContent` field. When embedding, use `contextualizedContent` instead of raw content. Tests verify context prefix for Pod, ConfigMap, Event, Log, Analyzer chunks.

steps.title: Phase 4: HyDE — Hypothetical Document Embeddings (2.4)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/ai-investigator.test.ts verifying: (1) `generateHypotheticalDocument(hypothesis, llmClient)` produces a detailed evidence-like text from a seed hypothesis, (2) the hypothetical document is embedded instead of the raw hypothesis for semantic search, (3) when LLM call fails, falls back to embedding the raw hypothesis. Then implement `generateHypotheticalDocument` in src/ai/hyde.ts. Wire into `investigateWithAI` in src/investigators/ai-investigator.ts: in Step 2b (semantic retrieval), call HyDE before `embeddingClient.embedSingle`. Tests mock the LLM client response. Export from src/ai/index.ts.

steps.title: Phase 4: Seed deduplication (2.10)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/ai-investigator.test.ts verifying: (1) `computeChunkOverlap(seedA, seedB, chunkIndex, resourceGraph, lexicalIndex)` returns the Jaccard similarity of their retrieved chunk sets, (2) `deduplicateSeeds(seeds, threshold=0.8)` merges seeds with >80% chunk overlap into combined multi-hypothesis seeds, (3) combined seeds produce a single LLM call with multiple hypotheses. Then implement `deduplicateSeeds` in src/investigators/ai-investigator.ts. Wire into `investigateWithAI` before the seed loop: after prioritization and before investigation, compute pairwise overlap for the top N seeds and merge high-overlap pairs. Tests verify: overlap computation, merge decision, combined prompt generation, reduced LLM calls.

steps.title: Phase 4: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify all Phase 4 changes compile correctly. Verify contextual retrieval, HyDE, and seed dedup integrate cleanly with the pipeline.

steps.title: Phase 5a: Unified diagnostic graph (4.1)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/diagnostic-graph.test.ts verifying: (1) `DiagnosticGraph` class supports all node types (resource, event, log-chunk, analyzer, finding, workload-group) and all edge types (owner-reference, references-secret, references-configmap, references-pvc, event-target, label-selector, service-selector, causes, supports, contradicts, correlates, temporal-correlation, temporal-sequence, derived-from), (2) nodes can be added with typed metadata, (3) edges carry type, weight, and direction, (4) `buildDiagnosticGraph(resources, events)` produces the same structural edges as the existing `buildResourceGraph`, (5) backward-compatible: existing `getRelatedChunks` works with the new graph type via an adapter or compatibility layer. Then implement src/graph/diagnostic-graph.ts merging ResourceRelationshipGraph + InvestigationGraphImpl into one unified graph. Add a `DiagnosticGraphNode` type covering all node categories. Preserve the existing `ResourceRelationshipGraph` interface as an adapter so callers aren't broken. Update src/graph/index.ts exports.

steps.title: Phase 5a: Label-selector and service-selector edges (4.3)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/diagnostic-graph.test.ts verifying: (1) when a Deployment has `spec.selector.matchLabels: {app: 'myapp'}` and Pods have matching `metadata.labels`, `label-selector` edges are created, (2) when a Service has `spec.selector: {app: 'myapp'}` and Pods have matching labels, `service-selector` edges are created, (3) edges work even when intermediate ReplicaSet is missing. Then implement in the `buildDiagnosticGraph` function (or extend `buildResourceGraph`): after adding all resource nodes, iterate Deployments/StatefulSets/DaemonSets and Services, match their selectors against all Pod labels, create appropriate edges. Tests use realistic fixture data with Deployments, Services, and Pods.

steps.title: Phase 5a: Typed weighted directional traversal engine (4.4)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/traversal.test.ts verifying: (1) `traverse({start, direction: 'forward', edgeTypes: ['causes'], maxDepth: 5})` follows only causes edges forward, (2) `traverse({start, direction: 'backward', edgeTypes: ['causes']})` walks backward for root-cause search, (3) `traverse({direction: 'both', edgeTypes: [...]})` walks both directions, (4) scoring decays with depth: `score = edge_weight × decay^depth` (default decay=0.7), (5) `traverseForChunks` variant returns scored chunks from graph-reached nodes, (6) replaces `getNeighborhoodWithDepth` BFS. Then implement src/graph/traversal.ts with `TraversalQuery` interface and `traverse`/`traverseForChunks` functions that work on `DiagnosticGraph`. Wire into `getRelatedChunks` as the new traversal backend. Existing tests must pass with the new traversal engine producing equivalent or better results.

steps.title: Phase 5a: Orchestrator dedup consolidation (7.8)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/orchestrator.test.ts verifying: (1) a two-pass dedup strategy: Pass 1 = component-based merge (structural, using graph node identity), Pass 2 = title-based dedup (cosmetic, catching LLM wording variants), (2) each pass has one normalization strategy and one merge strategy, (3) existing behavior is preserved: AI findings win over heuristic for same component, symptom suppression still works. Then refactor the dedup/merge layers in src/investigators/orchestrator.ts from five overlapping passes (hypothesis category dedup, AI-primary promotion, mergeHypothesisFindings, title-based dedup, symptom suppression) into two clean passes with a clear contract between them. Symptom suppression remains as a separate post-dedup filter since it serves a different purpose.

steps.title: Phase 5a: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify Phase 5a (unified graph, selectors, traversal, dedup) compiles correctly. Ensure all existing tests still pass with the new graph architecture.

steps.title: Phase 5b: Causal template library and investigator causal edges (4.2)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/kubernetes-investigator.test.ts and a new src/graph/__tests__/causal-templates.test.ts verifying: (1) a `CausalTemplate` type maps symptom→chain: e.g. MissingSecret→FailedMount→CrashLoopBackOff→DeploymentUnhealthy, (2) `matchCausalTemplate(findings, events, resources)` returns matched template instances with concrete node IDs, (3) investigators create `causes` edges encoding the diagnostic chain when they discover findings (e.g. kubernetes-investigator creates `finding:missing-secret:app-credentials ─causes─► event:FailedMount:app-pod ─causes─► finding:crashloop:app-pod`). Then implement: (1) Create src/graph/causal-templates.ts with template library and matcher, (2) modify src/investigators/kubernetes-investigator.ts to emit causes edges alongside findings, (3) modify src/investigators/log-investigator.ts similarly. Templates: MissingSecret→FailedMount→CrashLoopBackOff, BadImageTag→ErrImagePull→ImagePullBackOff, DNSFailure→ConnectionTimeout→ReadinessProbeFailure, OOMKill→ContainerRestart→CrashLoopBackOff, ConfigMapTypo→AuthFailure→PodNotReady, MissingStorageClass→ProvisioningFailed→FailedMount→PodPending.

steps.title: Phase 5b: Wire finding tree and root-cause presentation
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/finding-tree.test.ts verifying: (1) `buildFindingTree` now works with real causes edges from investigators (not just test fixtures), (2) `getRootCauses` returns the deepest root cause in each chain, (3) the finding tree produces a renderable causal tree: 'Missing Secret → FailedMount → CrashLoopBackOff → Unhealthy Workload'. Write tests in src/tui/__tests__/helpers.test.ts for a `formatCausalChain(findingTreeNode)` helper. Then implement: (1) Wire `buildFindingTree` into the orchestrator pipeline to produce the tree from investigation edges, (2) add the tree to `InvestigationResult`, (3) add `formatCausalChain` helper in src/tui/helpers.ts, (4) update FindingsPane.tsx to optionally show causal chain indicators. The finding tree is now real — `getRootCauses` returns actual root causes for the first time.

steps.title: Phase 5b: Cross-symptom hypothesis correlation (7.5)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/hypothesis-generator.test.ts verifying: (1) `correlateAcrossSymptoms(hypothesisSets)` detects when N symptom groups converge on the same root-cause category (e.g. all dns-failure) in the same namespace, (2) convergent hypotheses produce a meta-finding: 'Cluster-wide DNS failure affecting N pods in namespace X', (3) the meta-finding's confidence is boosted by convergence count. Then implement `correlateAcrossSymptoms` in src/investigators/hypothesis-generator.ts. Wire into the orchestrator after per-symptom hypothesis generation. Tests verify: 3 pods with DNS failures → single cluster-wide finding with boosted confidence.

steps.title: Phase 5b: Active falsification of hypotheses (7.6)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/hypothesis-evidence-collector.test.ts verifying: (1) for 'DNS failure' hypothesis, collector actively searches for successful DNS lookups/connections for the same hostname, (2) for 'missing Secret' hypothesis, collector checks whether the Secret is actually present, (3) for 'registry auth failure', collector searches for successful pulls from the same registry, (4) found falsifying evidence is added to `contradicting` array. Then implement: add a `collectFalsifyingEvidence(hypothesis, context)` function in src/investigators/hypothesis-evidence-collector.ts that defines what would disprove each hypothesis category and actively searches for it. Wire into `collectEvidenceForHypothesis`. Tests verify evidence is actively sought and found when present.

steps.title: Phase 5b: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify Phase 5b (causal edges, finding tree, cross-symptom correlation, active falsification) compiles correctly and all tests pass.

steps.title: Phase 5c: Temporal correlation edges (4.6)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/diagnostic-graph.test.ts verifying: (1) `addTemporalCorrelationEdges(graph, logChunks, events)` creates temporal-correlation edges when a log error at timestamp T matches an event within ±60 seconds targeting the same pod, (2) the time delta is stored as edge weight (closer = stronger), (3) `addTemporalSequenceEdges(graph, events)` creates temporal-sequence edges between sequential events targeting the same pod with causal affinity (e.g. FailedMount followed by BackOff). Then implement in src/graph/diagnostic-graph.ts by wiring the existing timeline module (src/parsers/timeline.ts — `sortEventsByTime`, `getEventWindow`, `correlateEventsWithPod`) into graph construction. The timeline module is finally used in production. Tests verify: temporal edges created, weights reflect time delta, event sequencing captured.

steps.title: Phase 5c: Hierarchical graph abstraction — workload groups (4.7 middle layer)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/diagnostic-graph.test.ts verifying: (1) `buildWorkloadGroups(graph)` creates virtual WorkloadGroup nodes from owner-reference + label-selector + references-* edges, (2) each WorkloadGroup contains its constituent Pods, Secrets, ConfigMaps, (3) WorkloadGroups connect to Services via service-selector edges, (4) traversal at workload level answers 'what's wrong with this deployment?' without enumerating individual pods. Then implement `buildWorkloadGroups` in src/graph/diagnostic-graph.ts. A WorkloadGroup is derived automatically from a Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet and all resources reachable via structural edges from it. Tests verify: workload groups are created, contain correct resources, connect to services.

steps.title: Phase 5c: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify Phase 5c (temporal edges, hierarchy) compiles correctly and all tests pass.

steps.title: Phase 5d: LLM knowledge extraction — triple extractor (4.5 part 1)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/knowledge-extractor.test.ts verifying: (1) `extractTriples(chunkContent, llmClient)` returns JSON triples like {source, relationship, target} from chunk text, (2) handles entity types: Pod, Deployment, Service, Secret, ConfigMap, Hostname, Image, Error, (3) handles relationship types: connects-to, configured-with, fails-because, authenticates-with, resolves-to, exposes, (4) triples are deduplicated, (5) graceful degradation when LLM fails. Then implement src/graph/knowledge-extractor.ts with extraction prompt per chunk and response parser. Tests mock LLM responses. Export from src/graph/index.ts.

steps.title: Phase 5d: Community detection and summaries (4.5 part 2)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/graph/__tests__/community.test.ts verifying: (1) `detectCommunities(graph)` returns clusters of related nodes using a Leiden-like label propagation algorithm (pure TypeScript, no external deps), (2) clusters correspond to application components (e.g. database stack, frontend stack), (3) `generateCommunitySummary(community, nodes)` produces a human-readable summary, (4) community summaries are stored as retrievable chunks. Then implement src/graph/community.ts with label propagation community detection (simpler than full Leiden but effective for K8s-scale graphs <10k nodes). Wire into the diagnostic graph as the top hierarchy layer (application components from 4.7). Tests use a realistic multi-namespace graph fixture.

steps.title: Phase 5d: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify Phase 5d (knowledge extraction, community detection) compiles correctly and all tests pass.

steps.title: Phase 5e: Graph-driven investigation (4.8)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/orchestrator.test.ts verifying: (1) when causal edges exist in the graph, the orchestrator uses graph traversal for root-cause search (backward along causes edges) instead of the procedural hypothesis generator, (2) the hypothesis generator is used as fallback when no causal template matches, (3) root causes are ranked by: causal path length, edge weights, evidence count, (4) the finding tree is built from causes edges. Then implement: modify src/investigators/orchestrator.ts to add a graph-query phase after investigators run. Build structural graph → run investigators (create finding + causes edges) → run causal template matching → root-cause query from each symptom → fallback to hypothesis generator for unmatched symptoms → build finding tree → rank and present. The existing procedural pipeline becomes the fallback path.

steps.title: Phase 5e: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify Phase 5e (graph-driven investigation) compiles correctly. This completes the entire Phase 5 graph architecture refactor.

steps.title: Phase 6: Services/Endpoints connectivity investigator (5.1)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/service-investigator.test.ts verifying: (1) `investigateServices(context, seeds)` checks whether Services referenced by pod env vars have matching Endpoints with ready addresses, (2) finding generated when 'Service my-service exists but has 0 ready endpoints', (3) cross-references with DNS failure findings from the log investigator, (4) creates causal edges in the diagnostic graph (ServiceNoEndpoints → ConnectionFailure → PodNotReady). Then implement src/investigators/service-investigator.ts. Wire into the orchestrator alongside the other investigators. Add 'service' to SeedCategory if needed. Tests use fixtures with Services, Endpoints, and Pods referencing services via env vars.

steps.title: Phase 6: NetworkPolicy investigator (5.2)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/network-policy-investigator.test.ts verifying: (1) `investigateNetworkPolicies(context, seeds)` parses NetworkPolicy resources, (2) detects when a NetworkPolicy's pod selector matches a failing pod and its egress/ingress rules would block traffic to the dependency it's trying to reach, (3) generates findings like 'NetworkPolicy X blocks egress from Pod Y to Service Z on port 5432', (4) creates causal edges. Then implement src/investigators/network-policy-investigator.ts. Wire into the orchestrator. Tests use fixtures with NetworkPolicy resources, failing pods, and blocked services.

steps.title: Phase 6: OOM investigator + Node health investigation (5.3 + 7.10)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/kubernetes-investigator.test.ts verifying: (1) OOMKilled termination reason detected in container statuses, (2) cross-reference with container resource limits vs requests, (3) finding generated: 'Container X in Pod Y was OOMKilled (limit: 256Mi)', (4) Node conditions checked: NotReady, MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure, (5) node-level findings correlate with pod scheduling failures. Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/seed-generator.test.ts for node-health seeds. Then implement: (1) extend src/investigators/kubernetes-investigator.ts with OOM detection and node condition checking, (2) add node-health seeds to src/investigators/seed-generator.ts (scan Node resources for unhealthy conditions), (3) create causal edges (OOMKill → ContainerRestart → CrashLoopBackOff, NodeNotReady → PodUnschedulable).

steps.title: Phase 6: Build verification
steps.description: Run full build to verify Phase 6 (new investigators) compiles correctly and all tests pass. This completes Phase 6.

steps.title: Tier 7: Spec recommender processes all findings (7.9)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/reporters/__tests__/spec-recommender.test.ts verifying: (1) `suggestFromHypothesisGaps` processes `finding:ai:*` findings (not just `finding:hypothesis:*`), (2) AI findings with `missingEvidence` entries generate spec recommendations, (3) close-confidence detection works across both AI and hypothesis findings. Then implement: change the `isHypothesisFinding` filter in src/reporters/spec-recommender.ts to include AI findings, or rename/broaden the function to cover all finding types with missingEvidence.

steps.title: Tier 7: Confidence quality indicator (7.12)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/types/__tests__/finding.test.ts (or src/investigators/__tests__/verifier.test.ts) verifying: (1) a `computeConfidenceQuality(finding)` function returns 'strong' | 'moderate' | 'weak' based on evidence count + specificity + missing decisive count, (2) 'strong' = ≥3 evidence items from ≥2 sources, 0 missing decisive, (3) 'moderate' = 2 evidence items OR 1 missing decisive, (4) 'weak' = 1 evidence item OR ≥2 missing decisive. Write tests in src/tui/__tests__/helpers.test.ts for `formatConfidenceWithQuality`. Then implement: (1) add optional `confidenceQuality?: 'strong' | 'moderate' | 'weak'` to `Finding` in src/types/finding.ts, (2) add `computeConfidenceQuality` to src/investigators/verifier.ts and apply during verification, (3) add `formatConfidenceWithQuality` to src/tui/helpers.ts, (4) update reporters to display quality alongside percentage.

steps.title: Tier 7: Declarative hypothesis templates (7.11)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in src/investigators/__tests__/hypothesis-generator.test.ts verifying: (1) a `HypothesisTemplate` type defines symptom→hypotheses mapping with evidence rules, (2) `loadTemplates()` returns the template registry, (3) `generateHypothesesFromTemplate(template, symptomFindings, context)` produces hypotheses matching the current procedural output, (4) adding a new template (e.g. 'oom-kill') requires no new TypeScript code — just a new entry in the registry. Then implement: (1) create src/investigators/hypothesis-templates.ts with a `HYPOTHESIS_TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` constant defining all templates as data (not code), (2) each template has: symptom pattern, hypothesis list with categories and rootCause strings, evidence_rules with supporting/contradicting patterns, (3) refactor src/investigators/hypothesis-generator.ts to read from the registry instead of hardcoded generator functions, (4) evidence collection rules are co-located with the template. Existing tests must produce identical output after refactor.

steps.title: Tier 7: Retrieval quality benchmark + confidence calibration (6.3 + 7.7)
steps.description: TDD: Write tests in test/retrieval/__tests__/benchmark.test.ts verifying: (1) a `computeRetrievalMetrics(retrieved, expected)` function computes precision@5, recall@5, and MRR, (2) metrics are correct for known input/output pairs. Then implement: (1) create scripts/benchmark-retrieval.mjs that runs all scenarios, logs retrieval stats per seed (which chunks retrieved, precision, recall, MRR), and outputs a summary report, (2) extend scripts/benchmark-hypotheses.mjs to track actual correctness per confidence band (are findings at 0.90 correct more often than 0.70?), (3) verify monotonicity: higher confidence bands should have higher accuracy. The benchmark is a regression gate for retrieval refactors. No scoring constant changes in this step — just measurement infrastructure.

steps.title: Final build verification and integration smoke test
steps.description: Run full lint, typecheck, unit tests, and build to verify the entire codebase compiles and all tests pass after all phases are complete. Verify that the pipeline end-to-end test (test/integration/__tests__/pipeline.test.ts) passes with all new investigators, graph architecture, and retrieval improvements active. This is the final quality gate for the complete implementation.
